question: According to Jesus, where would the apostles be witnesses, in order?
options: Samaria, Judea, Jerusalem, the ends of the earth
Jerusalem, Judea and Samaria, the ends of the earth
Galilee, Samaria, Jerusalem, the ends of the earth
explanation: Jesus said they would be His witnesses in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.
